messages:
oliver: FYI Orion Bank raised a procurement clause: 10y retention lanes, exportable tamper-evident bundles, and tenant-level legal-hold APIs. They pushed timeline to Q4 in the contract.

rika: Do we know if they will insist on BYOK from Day 1? Their security appendix leans that way but procurement said it's negotiable for pilots.

tom: From infra: we can produce tamper-evident bundles by adding a signed ledger and chunked exports. BYOK adds handshake complexity but architecturally doable later.

claudia: Compliance note: bundle must include event ordering, actor IDs, and a verifiable digest across chunks. Also need an auditable retention policy UI for account teams.

oliver: Proposal: break into MVP + BYOK follow-up. MVP: signed export bundles (platform key), tenant legal-hold toggle, and export manifest schema. Follow-up: customer KMS integration + escrow process.

tom: Quick estimate: MVP is ~1.5 eng-sprints (1 backend + 0.5 infra) to persist provenance fields, wire manifest signing, and add flag for retention bypass. Export runner changes another half-sprint.

rika: I'll map the MVP artifacts to SOC2/ISO controls and update contract language to show platform-signed bundles are interim acceptable.

claudia: UX ask: retention lanes config page needs tenant-facing labels and an override emergency button for legal hold. Ops will need audit logs when overrides are used.

audit-bot: Reminder: open compliance-ticket with customer name, retention term, manifest schema link, and BYOK preference.

oliver: Action list: @tom post low-level PR estimate + data-model diff by EOD; @rika attach SOC2 mapping and draft contract clause by Tue; @claudia draft UI copy and emergency-runbook. We'll decide in Q4 planning if estimates fit.

tom: I'll open CR-2201 and attach example manifest. Example minimal manifest:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "orion-bank-001",
  "exported_at": "2026-01-15T22:10:00Z",
  "chunks": 12,
  "digest": "sha256:...",
  "signature": "base64(...)"
}
```

oliver: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
